selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does the globe invite the traveler to look at first?
questions.answer: Its jobs and its signs, like pages to be read.

questions.question: What does the traveler notice when he looks at the earth’s pages?
questions.answer: He sees that they point again and again to the Lord of the earth.

questions.question: From what do the forms of many living things come out?
questions.answer: They come from a simple kind of material.

questions.question: What happens to some seeds in a wondrous way?
questions.answer: They are given ways to fly and spread to other places.

questions.question: From what unlikely things are many foods brought out?
questions.answer: They come from dry soil, roots, seeds, and small drops of liquid.

questions.question: What example is given to show special mercy toward babies?
questions.answer: Babies are given milk, especially through their mothers.

questions.question: What does spring show about the earth after winter-like death?
questions.answer: It shows the earth being brought back to life.

questions.question: What message does the earth give through all its pages?
questions.answer: That only Allah is truly worthy of worship.

questions.question: Why does the globe call the traveler back from the sky?
questions.answer: To show him on earth what he is searching for.

questions.question: How is the globe compared to a whirling dervish?
questions.answer: It is described as turning with two motions.

questions.question: Why is the globe called a grand ship?
questions.answer: Because it carries huge amounts of provisions for creatures.

questions.question: What does each page of the earth seem to do?
questions.answer: It declares the greatness and lordship of Allah.

questions.question: What shows great precision in spring?
questions.answer: The many forms of countless living things appear exactly as needed.

questions.question: What is amazing about some seeds?
questions.answer: Some are equipped to travel through the air.

questions.question: What does the passage say about food coming from the earth?
questions.answer: Delicious foods are brought out from things that seem plain and similar.

questions.question: Who receives these springtime supplies?
questions.answer: The living beings on earth.

questions.question: What final belief does the traveler understand from the earth’s pages?
questions.answer: He understands that all creation points to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What does the globe say it will show the traveler?
questions.answer: It will show him what he has been looking for.

questions.question: What pattern does the globe’s motion set up?
questions.answer: It sets the pattern of days, years, and seasons.

questions.question: What does the traveler learn by looking at the earth like a book?
questions.answer: He learns that its signs point to its Creator and Sustainer.

questions.question: What stands out about the birth of many species in spring?
questions.answer: So many forms appear from simple matter with exactness.

questions.question: What special gift is given to some seeds?
questions.answer: They are given a way to travel through the air.

questions.question: What kinds of things become food according to the passage?
questions.answer: Soil, roots, seeds, and tiny drops become many foods.

questions.question: How does reviving the earth support belief in life after death?
questions.answer: If dead-looking earth can live again, bringing people back to life is also possible.
